mapper.select: SELECT CONTACT_ID AS contactId, CATEGORY AS category, TITLE AS title, PHONE AS phone, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDate FROM EMERGENCY_CONTACT ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CONTACT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMERGENCY_CONTACT ( CONTACT_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, PHONE, SORT_ORDER ) VALUES ( SEQ_EMERGENCY_CONTACT.NEXTVAL, #{category}, #{title}, #{phone}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMERGENCY_CONTACT SET CATEGORY = #{category}, TITLE = #{title}, PHONE = #{phone}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder} WHERE CONTACT_ID = #{contactId}
